about: CHECK THE PATHS BEFORE A RUN. Built around the owner's real teach-question target in the ML Harness repo: client.ts -> app/main.py -> app/providers/__init__.py, plus app/diagnosis.py. The paths are the ones earlier teach runs printed (frontend/src/lib/engine/client.ts, app/main.py, app/providers/__init__.py, app/diagnosis.py) and have NOT been checked against a scan of that repo. Run with --emit-prompts first: the driver prints a CHECK line for every focus or expectPath entry that names no node, and for every expected hop that is not a scan edge (a grounded answer cannot draw a hop the scan lacks). Fix those lines here, then run live.

questions.question: Teach me how a question typed in the frontend reaches the model provider. Draw the path through the code.
Where does app/main.py hand a failing run to diagnosis? Draw the hop.
Draw the whole ask: from the frontend client to the server, then to the providers and to diagnosis.
What calls app/providers/__init__.py? Draw every caller with an arrow to it.
